༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje zla gsang gi tshe sgrub 'chi bdag 'joms pa zhes bya ba bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje zla gsang gi tshe sgrub 'chi bdag 'joms pa zhes bya ba bzhugs

so// bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ 'di nyid la lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pas 'chi med tshe'i sgrub pa bya ba ni gnyis/ bdag don du bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don tu dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ dben zhing nyams dga' ba sngar rab tu gnas pa bgyis pa'i shul du stegs bu ji ltar 'tsham pa dri bzang gis sbags shing me tog gi gcal bkram pa'i dbus su/ dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi mthing kha nang gi mu khyud ser po'i lte bar zla gam kha sprod dmar po'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag /rtsibs mdun du ya mthing nag /g.yas su ya dmar nag /rgyab tu ya nag po/ g.yon du bh+yo smug nag /de'i phyir mu khyud ljang khu rtsibs mtshams dang zla gam phyi mdzes tshon/ de'i phyir thod skam gyi ra ba dang me ri bris pa'i dbus su/ bum pa mgul chings nag po can gyi nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang bum rdzas nyer lnga/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma chang rnams bsres pas sum gnyis bkang ba/ 'bras bu'i shing gis kha brgyan pa'i gseb tu rdo rje rtse lnga pa la srad bu sna lnga btags pa bzhag |dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du srog gi rten rin po che'i rdo rje rtse lnga srog khams kyi mdog dang mthun pa'i dar gyis sked bcings pa/ mchan/ pa gas chag med pa/ g.yas su dbang thang gi rten thod pa mtshan ldan a mṛ ta su ra dang sbyar mar gyi tshe ril btab /mchan/ ba'i kha dar gyis dbang thang gi khams dang mthun pas/ mchan/ bkab pa'i steng du/ me long la sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung lte bar hūm̐ bris pas bkab pa/ rgyab tu rlung rta'i rten mda' rgod sgro ma lcags kyi mde'u sngar sa la ma bab pa/ rlung rta'i khams dang mdog mthun pa'i dar kha gru ma nyams pa dang*/ mchan/

me long la gser g.yu mu tig byi ru rnams tshar du sbreng ba btags pa/ g.yon du lus kyi rten rtags kyi phur bu mtho gang ba cod pan lus kyi khams dang mthun pa'i dar/ mchan/ can/ de rnams kyi mdun du gtor ma bra bo lta bu 'khor bzhi/ mtshams rnams su ong skyu can/ dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa'i g.yas su sman/ g.yon du rak+ta/ de rnams kyi phyi skor shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab/ byang du zhal zas/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog rnams bsham/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du rdor dril/ thod rnga sogs nyer mkho rnams bsham/ stan bde bar 'dug /phyi nang mtshams dam du bcad/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bgegs rnams la gtor ma byin la bka' bsgo/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ bkrag mdangs mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur bar byas la/ a sa ma ya mañdzu shrī mu dra a kro te ka ā yuḥpha la sid+dhi bh+rūṃ āḥ zhes bzla/ sngags 'di'i yon tan ni/ 'jam dpal las bzhi'i 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud le'u brgyad pa las/ de yis tshe yi dbang thob nas// sangs rgyas sku dang mnyam pa dang*// skal pa ma zhig bar du ni// lo lnga lon pa bzhin du gnas// zhes gsungs pas bzlas pa bya// slar yang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ zhes brjod pas dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus par byas zhes pa nas/ 'khor dang nor rdzas thams cad gsal bar gyur| bar gyis gtso bo dang rang tshe bdag ces pa dor nas/ yab kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag cig 'phros pa sogs kyi rtsibs g.yon du yum/ g.yas su sras mchog /mdun du sku sprul/ rgyab tu gsung sprul bskyed la srung 'khor dang spyan 'dren nas/ bkrag mdangs mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don ltar byas nas/

bdag bskyed kyi bsnyen pa de nyid byas/ slar bum pa bskyed pa la'ang bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings shing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ ya ma ti ra baṃ nas/ bkrag mdangs mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ lha bskyed pa'i tshe rang nyid ces pa dang*/ rang tshe bdag tu gsal ba ces pa dor gzhan 'dra/ de rjes kyi bdag bskyed kyi sngags bzla skabs su/ oṃ a kro te ka ā yuḥpha la ya mān+ta ka ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyang ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ gtso cher bdag bskyed sngags sngags bzla ba'i tshe dmigs pa gtso che gsungs pa'i skabs nyid ltar 'bad cing*/ bum mdun gyis sngags bzla ba'i tshe skabs skabs su/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros bum mdun gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la phog thugs brgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum 'khor 'das thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor bsdus te bum sogs tshe rdzas thams cad la thim par bsam pa skabs skabs su bya'o// mchan/ la 'bad/ thun mtshams rnams su bsam gtan bum pa'i cho ga ltar bum pa bsgrub/ logs su byas pa'i chus khrus bya/ sman raka gtor ma rgyas par 'bul/ bstod pa bya/ dgong thun la tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ nyal khar a+yai ring tshar gsum brjod pas snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ba rang dang bum mdun gyi lha la bstims shing lha rnams dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gsal btab nas/ oṃ nṛ bh+rūṃ badz+ra āḥyuḥṣe hūm̐ āḥ lcags sdig stod dril nyi ma shar ba byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde las/ 'di la khri 'bum bzlas gyur na// nyi zla chur gsal tshe ring 'gyur// zhes sogs sngags 'di la phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs so// mchan/

zhes pa stong las mi nyung bar bzla ste gnyid log pa'i tshe oṃ la rngub āḥl gnas hūm̐ la 'phros pas rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i ngang du nyal/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'di yang*/ byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde las/ oṃ la brngubs la hūm̐ la 'phros// āḥl gnas pa'i rlung nyid bzung*// 'di la rtag tu goms par bya// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas spyod rnams// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi gnas par bsam// zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ la rngub/ āḥl bum can ci thub bzung*/ mi thub tshe hūm̐ gis btang yang dus rgyun tu 'byung 'jug gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das par bya'o// mchan/ nangs par bdag bskyed gong ltar bya zhing bdag mdun bum gsum gsal ba'i dmigs pa nas/ bdag bskyed kyi skabs bshad pa'i sngags gtso bor bzla zhing skabs skabs su rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad tshe bcud ro nus phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bkug nas| srog lus ngag rlung gi rten rnams la thim par yang yang bsam zhing*/ mtshams dam du bcad nas bzlas pas/ lha'i rtags tshod 'dzin nang rtags drod tshad nas rnyed pa ltar dang tshe bsrings ba'i rtags/ nyi zla shar ba/ shel phreng rnyed pa/ chu bo chen po 'thung pa sogs/ tshe sgrub spyi nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams 'byung bas/ rtags ma byung gi bar du bzlas pa la 'bad/ tshe bsrings ba'i rtags kyi nges pa brtan po lan gsum yan chad byung nas/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyas par byas la/ bum pa'i lha rnams byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu ba/ bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par dmigs/ las bum zhig dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon ltar bsgrubs pas khrus byas nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dbang rnams bdag 'jug blang*/ mthar bum chu dang thod chang rnams dngos grub tu rol/ rdo rje phur bu lus dang mi bral bar bcang*/ mda' dar rnams dben par bzhag /sman raka gtor ma rnams la dngos grub blang ba dang*/

las mjug spyi 'gro ltar bya/ dus rtag tu bdag bskyed kyi skabs bshad pa'i sngags dang nyal ba'i dus su sngags thung gnyis ma chag par bzlas pas dus min 'chi ba'i skag las grol zhing lo zla zhag dus kyi skag las grol ba myong bas grub pa yin no// gnyis pa gzhan don du tshe dbang bskur ba ni/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ slob ma rang dang dam tshig gcig pa mtshan ldan rnams 'jug yon dang bcas gral la 'khod/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ bgegs la gtor ma byin zhing bka' bsgo srung 'khor bsgom/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// gyi bar gsol ba btab/ slar yang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi| |nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum gyis rgyun bshags byas la/ las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ya ma ti ra baṃ/ zhes pa nas/ rang lus las 'phros pa'i me ri dang me phung tsha tsha 'phro ba'i nang du bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bor bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ slob ma la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza dzñā na sarba satwa sa pa ri wā ra ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes brjod cing rol mo bsgrags/ gu gul bdug /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ slob mas/ hoḥ slob dpon 'jam dpal tshe yi bdag /phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /dregs pa 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs| |bdag cag 'khor ba las grol zhing*// srid pa'i don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir// 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi// 'chi med grub pa'i dbang stsol cig

/gsum gyis gsol ba btab| mdun gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ slob ma'i dpral bar bstims/ gti mug gi dri ma dag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi tshe dbang thob/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam zhing*/ dbus kyi bum pa mgor bzhag la/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu kun 'dus pa'i// ye shes rgyal po thig le 'di// gsang chen rmad du byung ba ste// rgyud drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i bcud// thams cad ma lus chos so cog /chos kyi sku yi chos kyi dbyings// don dam tshig dang mngon sum yang*// dngos po mtshan ma thams cad la// khyab pa'i myang 'das thugs rje che// phra mo sems kyi rang bzhin te// gti mug mun pa sel ba'i mchog /nyon mongs dri ma kun dang bral// shin tu sad pa mya ngan 'das// thugs rje'i rang bzhin gshin rje'i gshed// rdo rje tshe'i rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'o// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ā yudzñā na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ bum chu khar sbyin/ yang mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ slob ma'i snying khar bstims/ zhe sdang gi dri ma dag |rdo rje'i rigs kyi tshe dbang thob/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ srog gi rten rdo rje slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ye nas dben// bde gshegs thams cad ye nas lhun gyis grub// mtha' bral spangs pa'i ye shes lhun rdzogs pa'i// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten stong khams rgyan du byas// thams cad shes rab kyi ni dbang bskur na// bdud dang srin po ma lus tshe bsdus nas// dbang bskur snang ba des kyang byin bskyed de// shar phyogs dri za'i lag nas tshe drongs shig

/rdo rje'i rigs las grub pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis// mgon po gshin rje'i tshe dbang bskur// oṃ badz+ra ku la e swa shwa na ha ha ho hoḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ yang mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ slob ma'i mgrin par bstims/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /pad+ma'i rigs kyi tshe dbang thob/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ dbang thang gi rten thod pa mgrin par bzhag la/ e ma hoḥkhro gtum rngam pa'i tshogs// pad+ma'i rigs kyi dbang phyug che// snang ba med par lhun gyis grub// pad+ma 'chang bas dbang bskur bas// klu 'dul tshe yi dbang thob shog /nub phyogs chu bdag lag nas tshe drongs shig /lhun gyis grub pa tshe yi dbang*// thogs med dam pa thob par shog /oṃ pad+ma ku la ā yuḥhe he ho hoḥhaṃ/ zhes bskur/ tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ yang mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi lte ba nas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ slob ma'i lte bar bstims/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma dag /rin po che'i rigs kyi tshe dbang thob/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ rlung rta'i rten mda' dar sogs lte bar bzhag la/ e ma hoḥ rin chen 'chang ba kun gyi bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug dbang med pa// gtso mchog khyad par byin brlabs te// mi 'gyur rigs kyi tshe thob nas// lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag nas tshe drongs shig /rin chen dgyes pa'i dbang bskur bas// khyad par byin rlabs thob par shog /oṃ rat+na ku la ā yuḥhe he ho hoḥhaṃ/ zhes bskur/ de nas lha tshogs rnams kyi gsang gnas nas 'od zer ljang khu 'phros/ slob ma'i gsang gnas la bstims/ phrag dog gi dri ma dag /las kyi rigs kyi tshe dbang thob/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/

don yod grub pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsams la/ lus kyi rten phur bu gsang bar gtad la| e ma hoḥ rang bzhin mtshan ma med pa yi// ye shes lnga ldan phrin las gtso// gnyis su med pa'i las kyi rigs// las rnams kun gyi dbang bskur bas// gnod sbyin lag nas tshe drongs la// gnod sbyin bgegs 'dul dbang thob shog /oṃ karma ku la ā yuḥhe he ho hoḥhaṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ de nas tshe gta' bsdam pa ni/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ka nas las kyi gshin rje tshon gang ba/ dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu lnga re spros pa/ slob ma'i spyi mgrin snying lte gsang bar thim pas srog lus dbang thang rlung rta'i tshe spel ba thams cad srung bar bsams la las bum gnas lngar gtugs shing bum chu khar sbyin la/ hoḥ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi// las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che// dmar nag nyi zla'i 'od zer can// hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing rab tu gtum// spyan gsum be con dgra snying 'dzin// dur khrod chas brgyan srog gi bdag /khyod kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di'i// srog lus dbang thang rlung rta'i stobs// bskyed cing tshe yi bar chad srungs// srog gi dbang po yun du gnas// lus la na tsha bgres rgud bral// dbang thang longs spyod dpal 'byor spel// rlung rta ya ga bzang por sgrogs// nyes tshogs thams cad gzhom pa dang*// tshe la gta' bsdams gces par zung*// oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza rak+ṣaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod/ rgyas gdab pa ni/ me long gi sin+dhu ra slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yas pas blangs pa slob ma'i gnas lngar thig le bya zhing*/ hoḥ rgyal ba kun 'dus 'jam dpal dbyangs// phyag rgya zil gnon tshe yi bdag /yab yum sras sprul 'khor tshogs bcas// las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che// dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas rnams la// skal ldan rdo rje slob ma 'di'i// tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di zung*// lus bskyed dbang thang 'phel zhing dar// rlung rta mdzes pa'i ba dan phyor// tshe la ye shes 'khor lo'i rgya// chos dbyings ye shes chen por btab// gong gi tshig tha ma gnyis kyi mal du 'gre'o/

/srog la ye shes rdo rje'i rgya// me long ye shes chen por btab| |zhes dang*/ lus la ye shes rin chen rgya// mnyam nyid ye shes chen por btab// zhes dang*/ dbang thang ye shes pad+ma'i rgya// sor rtog ye shes chen por btab// zhes dang*/ rlung rta rgya gram ye shes rgya// bya grub ye shes chen por btab// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba lnga'i// phyag rgya lnga yis rgyas btab pas// bskal par gzhig kyang mi 'jig go// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ mu dra sa ma ya hoḥ zhes thig le bya'o// gsum pa mjug dngos grub blang ba ni/ sman rag gtor gsum slob ma'i lag tu gtad cing khar sbyin la/ hoḥ 'dod yon mi zad dgos 'dod re ba skong*// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med sman gyi gtso// rgyu rkyen kun sbyar ma hā rak+ta dang*// dam rdzas kun 'dus rmad byung gtor ma'i mchog /'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi 'khor lo bcas// skal ldan bu la deng 'dir ngas gtad kyi// 'dod yon lhun grub bde gshegs phun tshogs shog /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba pañtsa ma hā rak+ta ba ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes dang*/ tshogs la longs spyod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang yon dbul/ rjes kyi cho ga sman raka gtor 'bul/ mchod bstod/ gshegs bsdu/ shis brjod bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// yang nad pa sogs la tshe dbang bsdus pa byed na mjug gi dngos grub len chog ma byas kyang chog go// zhib cha 'ga' zhig ni slob dpon dgyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par bya dgos so// zhes pa'ang zla gsang rgyud kyi 'gyur med tshe'i le'u zhe brgyad pa dang*/ 'jam dpal las bzhi'i 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi 'jam dpal tshe sgrub pa'i le'u brgyad pa sogs las bstus te bdag don du tshe sgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don du dbang bskur ba'i tshul mdor bsdus pa ste/
chu bya zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer bdun la gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa chos kyi grags pas/ bye ri stag rtse'i kun gsal gsang sngags pho brang du sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
